_doc: Reference data for benchmarking the Castor pipeline against an AI-driven sales engagement B2B SaaS for B2B mid-market companies.

venture_under_test.name: Cadenz
venture_under_test.description: Cadenz is a B2B SaaS sales engagement platform with AI-driven multi-channel sequence orchestration for B2B SaaS companies with 50-1000 employees. We replace Outreach/Salesloft with an LLM-native cadence builder that auto-personalizes emails per prospect from CRM signals, schedules calls based on engagement intent, and writes follow-ups conditional on prospect's actual reply text. Pricing is $95 per seat per month for the standard tier and $145 per seat for the AI-personalization tier. Target buyer: VP Sales, Director of Sales Operations, and Head of RevOps. We compete with Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, Gong Engage, and HubSpot Sales Hub. Differentiation: AI-personalization happens at-send time per email (not pre-built templates), conversational reply-classification routes prospect responses without manual triage, and seat pricing 30-40% below the category median.
